cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Outdo the Effort
cards.instruction: Answer every favor, chore, or sacrifice with a bigger one that restores your lead.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like to keep this voluntary. Thanks for the lift. I'll cover your Saturday shift. Please.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: No need. I covered yours yesterday so you could rest.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still in charge; we can make an adjustment. Then I'll take your whole weekend. You shouldn't be doing more than me.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I've already swapped Sunday to drive you to the airport.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then I'll cancel my flight and cover your holiday. You deserve the longer break.

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 shift for lift and A5 holiday cover escalate favors, but A3 charge preface supplies little genuine adaptation to retain cooperation.

responseLogic.evidence: B2 earlier shift cover causes A3 whole weekend; B4 airport arrangement causes A5 cancellation and holiday cover.

relationship.evidence: B2 and B4 reveal actual help rather than competing deliberately; A keeps trying to outgive it.

heightening.evidence: A5 sacrifices the trip itself to surpass the effort of getting A there.

specificity.evidence: A1 lift and work shifts plus B4 airport establish ordinary responsibilities.
